description: This file defines a generic internal implementation of an asynchronous stream for the Orleans framework, including stream subscription management, message handling, and stream lifecycle controls.

classes.name: StreamImpl<T>
classes.description: A sealed internal class implementing Orleans streaming interfaces for asynchronous message streaming, supporting subscription, message passing, and control operations.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to the stream with optional sequence token and filter data.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up producer and/or consumer interfaces associated with the stream.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Publishes an item to the stream.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Publishes a batch of items to the stream.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Signals an error condition on the stream.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription with a specified handle and observer.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptionHandles
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription handles for the stream.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific subscription handle.

methods.name: GetProducerInterface
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the producer interface for the stream.

methods.name: GetConsumerInterface
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the consumer interface for the stream.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the stream provider from the runtime client, based on the provider name.
